newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - SHARE PRICES EASE ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - SHARE PRICES EASE ON BOURSE.

text.p: Price falls in several of the
leading shares brought the Namibia Stock Exchange indices lower
Wholesale, packaging and manufacturing group CIC Holdings
saw the heaviest trade with 2.1 million shares traded
at prices ranging as high as N$3.05 but it ended the week at
N$2.95. Namibia Breweries also saw busy trade with
prices reaching as high as N$3.10 but ending the week at N$3.00
McCarthy Retail bucked the trend with its price
Over 2.71 million shares were traded valued at N$12.7
million. The NSE overall index slipped slightly to end the week
The local index ended at 164.28, down from 166.77 points the
